user.title: Sign in to KUB
user.description: Click the link below to sign in with your KUB account.

auth_code.title: Enter authorization code
auth_code.description:
1. [Sign in to KUB]({authorize_url})
2. After login, you'll be redirected to kub.org
3. Copy the `code` value from the URL bar
4. Paste it below

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. The code may have expired — try again.
